defect_reproduced_first.root_cause: self-referential provenance guard: it read git rev-parse HEAD:<binder> and compared it to the PRE-candidate baseline. Committing the candidate necessarily moves HEAD to the candidate blob, so the guard could only pass while the production edit was UNCOMMITTED. On every committed SHA of the candidate it failed, so the candidate's own court was 15/16 on exactly the artefact it was meant to certify.

git_available_in_worktree.reconciliation_with_R01: R01 reported 10 failed / 6 passed and described the tenth as a no-git /tmp terrain artifact while the author's P01 run showed 9/7. Both numbers are correct and they differ by exactly the provenance test, whose count depends on whether production is committed. Pre-repair it could only ever fail; after the repair it FAILS MEANINGFULLY when the candidate is absent from disk and PASSES when the reviewed candidate is present.
